description: React component for the HomePage view, displaying notes with filtering, pagination, and navigation features.

methods.name: HomePage()
methods.description: Main React functional component for the homepage, managing notes display, filters, pagination, and user interactions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Asynchronous function that fetches notes based on current query parameters, updating state accordingly.

methods.name: onApplyFilters
methods.description: Handles applying search and filter criteria, resetting to page 1 and updating query state.

methods.name: onOpen
methods.description: Navigates to the note detail page for the specified note ID.

methods.name: onDownload
methods.description: Placeholder function to trigger note download; currently shows an alert.

methods.name: EmptyState
methods.description: Component displayed when no notes match filters, providing an option to clear filters.

methods.name: ErrorState
methods.description: Component shown when loading notes fails, offering retry and reset options.

methods.name: Pagination
methods.description: Component for navigating between pages of notes, showing total results and page controls.
